description: Per class role ratings for the Guide class roles table (feature/aetherium-guide-home, 18 Oct 2026). Each rating is the source's own tier, tagged Reported on the page and cited; it is the source's view, never ours. A role the source does not rank is pending: the page then shows what our build data says (main role, can play, pending or a dash). Only one source found grades classes per role (MeinMMO PvE tier list: Damage, Tanks and Healers, no Support list); other sources give role words, not grades, and are not used here.

tank.evidence: Ranked second of the two tanks: can hold the boss when no Templar is in the group.

healer.reason: The source does not rank this class for this role.

support.reason: The source has no Support tier list.

dps.evidence: In the top damage group (no class is ranked S for damage).
